L30·N7471unmasked layer
Fires on a "continuation" token inside a multi-token proper name or numeric string — a digit within a year/phone number, a CJK character in a transliterated Chinese name, or the next word/letter of a proper-noun sequence (e.g. "Cameron" after "Cal Bear", "G" after "GONDIA JUNCTION") — with the polarity flipping negative on very similar year-digit contexts, so it looks like a positional/prediction feature rather than a semantic one.
